video_caption: The video opens with an exterior shot of a large, classical-style building with columns, identified by the CNBC logo in the top right, as several individuals in suits and military uniforms walk on a paved path and lawn. A male voice states, "that the Department of Defense first started funding brain computer interface research." This transitions to a grayscale MRI scan of a human brain, then to a distorted indoor scene showing a man with a prosthetic arm talking to a woman. The building and brain scan reappear with a purple filter and glitch effects, as the audio phrase "Department of Defense first started funding" repeats and distorts. The screen briefly goes black before transitioning to an animated segment. This segment first shows a white desktop computer displaying code, then expands to include a meeting room with four people and a presenter. Next, an animated blue outline of a smart home at night illustrates interconnected devices via wifi signals, controlled by a smartphone. The scene then cuts to a close-up of a green Dettol cleaning product bottle, with the text "KILLS 99.9% of BACTERIA" highlighted by a red circle, while the voice discusses the remaining 0.1% of bacteria. This leads to a shot of a hand holding an iPhone X, first viewing an email with a canoeing photo, then swiping to the home screen. Another hand is then shown force-touching the Mail app icon on an older iPhone, revealing a context menu. Finally, the video ends with a close-up of fingers rapidly typing the word "gibberish" repeatedly on an iPhone keyboard, accompanied by typing sounds.

The video opens with a man, wearing a black beanie, glasses, and a dark beard, speaking into a microphone, with a white speech bubble background displaying the text "SMILE 2 JANNAH". This transitions to an animated title card with "SMILE" (with a smiley face instead of 'I') in orange and "JANNAH 2" in blue, set against a light sky. Following a black screen, a sequence of visuals depicts brain-related technology: a glowing, digital brain with electrical impulses, a person wearing an EEG cap on a black background with directional arrows, and Keanu Reeves from "The Matrix" with data scrolling over his face and the superimposed text "I KNOW KUNG FU." This is followed by Alex Jones wearing a foil hat and smiling, and then Charlie Day from "It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia" appearing as a conspiracy theorist in front of a board covered with notes and strings, labeled "PEPE SILVIA." The video then displays news headlines: "Elon Musk reveals brain-hacking plans" (BBC News, 17 July 2019), "Elon Musk's Neuralink reveals BRAIN chip that could enable 'superhuman intelligence'" (Mirror, 17 July 2019), and "Elon Musk claims robot surgeon will sew electrodes into human brains in 2020" (MashableUK). The segment concludes with the initial man looking wide-eyed and shocked, his mouth agape, returning to the "SMILE 2 JANNAH" background.

The video segment begins with a close-up of Elon Musk, smiling broadly and looking towards the right side of the frame, dressed in a black suit, white shirt, and black bow tie against a soft, light-colored background. This transitions to a wide shot of a white SpaceX rocket launching, with a bright orange flame and white smoke emanating from its base, positioned next to a white building clearly labeled "SPACEX" with an American flag logo, all under a blue sky with scattered clouds. The next shot features a shiny red Tesla Model 3 car connected to a white Tesla Supercharger station, with the "TESLA" logo visible on the charging unit. Following this, a man with a dark beard and a black cap is shown speaking into a microphone, looking slightly upwards, with a dynamic, white, cloud-shaped graphic behind him that displays the text "SNEAK 2 HALAL" in yellow and orange letters. The scene then returns to Elon Musk, who is standing on a dark stage, wearing a black suit over a white shirt, holding a dark object in his left hand while gesturing with both hands. Behind him, a screen displays a glowing blue, circuit board-like image of a human brain in the upper left corner, and the word "Neuralink" in a light blue, pixelated font below it. The final shot is a screenshot of a news article from "FASTCOMPANY" with the prominent headline: "Elon Musk's Neuralink plans to start human trials next year for brain-computer implants." (This headline indicates that Elon Musk's company, Neuralink, is planning to initiate human testing for its brain-computer interface technology in the coming year.) Below the headline, a photograph credited to Micaele Parente/Unsplash shows a collection of human skulls, varying in size, displayed neatly in rows on a wall.

The video segment begins with a series of black and white medical imaging scans of a human brain, including axial, coronal, and vascular views, which then transition to an axial scan overlaid with glowing cyan geometric patterns, suggesting digital interaction or data flow. This gradually shifts to a dynamic, dark, and abstract 3D rendering of a human head and brain, with swirling textures and reddish highlights, before revealing the CNBC logo in the upper right corner. The scene then cuts to a young man with dark hair, wearing a dark hooded sweatshirt, adjusting a white earbud in his ear, set against a plain light background. The video then transitions to a man with a black beanie, glasses, and a dark beard, speaking animatedly into a microphone. He wears a dark green jacket, and behind him is a large white speech bubble graphic with the text "SNEE 2 HALLAH" in bold yellow and orange letters, as he gestures with his hands while speaking.

The video segment opens with a close-up of a person's forearm wearing a sophisticated electronic bracelet composed of circuit boards and wires, followed by a man with an EEG cap on his head, seated in a wheelchair, intently looking at a computer monitor, with a name tag reading "14 KIM penBMI" visible. This transitions to another man, also wearing an EEG cap and glasses, with a goatee, smiling slightly while looking at a computer screen. The next shot shows a person from behind, wearing a white EEG cap, observing a monitor displaying a grid of red, yellow, and grey circles, followed by a robotic arm with a green laser beam working on a small component. The scene then shifts to a close-up of a robotic, silvery-grey face with intricate mechanical details and glowing blue eyes, before showing a human forearm connected to a red smartphone, which in turn is linked to a white robotic hand with black fingers. A black screen briefly appears with the white text "HOW?". The video then showcases a series of images depicting cyborgs and augmented humans from popular culture: Iron Man in his suit, Robocop holding a weapon, and Cyborg from Justice League. The segment concludes with a nine-panel collage of album covers and promotional images featuring celebrities and characters with robotic or cybernetic enhancements, including Nicki Minaj, Janelle Monáe, Miley Cyrus, Christina Aguilera, and the Terminator, highlighting the prevalence of cybernetic themes in entertainment.

In the video segment, a man with a dark beard, glasses, and a black beanie, wearing a dark jacket over a dark shirt, stands before a microphone. He is highly animated, frequently leaning left and right, and making exaggerated gestures with his hands, often pointing to his head with both index fingers, to emphasize his points. His facial expressions shift from wide-eyed surprise and intensity to a broad, somewhat mischievous smile, with his mouth often open as if speaking or exclaiming. Behind him, against a white background, is a large, comic-book-style speech bubble graphic that reads "SMILE 2 ALLAH," with "SMILE 2" in yellow/orange and "ALLAH" in red/orange, suggesting a theme of encouraging happiness or good deeds in the context of faith.

The video opens with a close-up shot of a person sitting in a black leather chair, wearing a black long-sleeved shirt and black pants, with a sophisticated, dark grey robotic prosthetic arm visible on their right side, featuring a flexible, jointed hand. The background is blurred, showing green text that appears to say "Tech." The scene then transitions to a different environment, where a woman wearing glasses and a red top is seated, and a blue and white robotic arm with a grey gripper approaches her, holding a red bottle with a straw. The robot carefully guides the straw into the woman's mouth, and she looks up at it, ready to drink. A man wearing glasses is visible in the background, observing the interaction.

The video opens with an animated visualization of a network of neurons, showing electrical signals (blue lights) moving through them and then a bright blue pulse and expanding ripple effect from a central neuron (0:00-0:12). An orange needle-like electrode is then shown inserting into the neuron, causing a similar blue ripple effect around its tip, with the text "Electrode" (0:12-0:21). This transitions to a graphic of a human brain with highlighted red and white areas, an arrow, the word "Decode," and a translucent 3D model of a mouth with a grid on the tongue, implying brain activity being decoded into speech (0:21-0:23). A man with a black beanie, glasses, and a long black beard, wearing a dark green jacket, is then shown speaking into a microphone, looking directly at the camera with an expressive, slightly concerned face; behind him is a white speech bubble with orange and red text that reads "SMILE 2 ALLAH" (0:23-0:26). A black screen with white text "SO HOW DOES IT HAPPEN?" appears (0:26-0:27), followed by a close-up of hair-thin wires being inserted into an organic, yellowish-brown surface, likely representing brain tissue, which then changes color to blue (0:27-0:31). A shot of a complex robotic arm with many wires and mechanical parts, presumably performing a precise task, is shown next (0:31-0:35), before cutting to two surgeons in blue scrubs, masks, and gloves operating on a patient in a brightly lit room, with a medical monitor displaying vital signs nearby (0:35-0:39). The man from earlier reappears, gesturing emphatically and expressing his strong disapproval of the brain implantation, with an animated graphic "CONTROL NUMBER 1" (0:49) appearing in the bottom left corner as he speaks. Logos for "c|net" and "CNBC" are visible in various segments.

In this video segment, a man with a dark beard, black beanie, and glasses is seen speaking emphatically into a microphone, wearing a dark green jacket. His expressions range from smiling to serious, and he uses frequent hand gestures to emphasize his points. The background features a large, cartoonish thought bubble with the text "SMASH 2 ALLAH" in yellow and orange. At 00:29, the scene briefly cuts to a futuristic image of a man in a suit wearing augmented reality glasses, with holographic data projections emanating from them against a dark blue, digital background. The video then returns to the main speaker. From 00:41, an orange-framed graphic appears in the lower-left corner with the white text "LESS HUMAN" and "NUMBER 2" below it, along with a numerical code "zg0261" and "az8". This graphic changes at 01:09 to display "TRUST" and "NUMBER 3" with new codes, while the man continues his discourse. At 01:31, a small inset image of an Asian man with a white bandage around his head appears on the right side of the screen, staying for a brief moment before disappearing, as the speaker continues his passionate address, occasionally leaning closer to the microphone and maintaining eye contact with the viewer.

The video features a man with a black beanie, glasses, and a long dark beard, wearing a dark green jacket, who speaks into a microphone against a white background with a large, comic-book-style speech bubble graphic that reads "SMILE 2 JANNAH" in yellow and red block letters. He frequently uses hand gestures, ranging from illustrative movements to a thumbs-up and thumbs-down, and later a saluting gesture followed by a "shaka" (hang loose) sign. His expressions vary from serious and thoughtful to more relaxed and smiling. At one point, an abstract digital animation of light blue interconnected lines and dots on a black background flashes across the screen. The video then cuts to two men in dark suits, including Elon Musk, seated in white chairs on a stage with a plain light-colored background, discussing AI. Elon Musk is seen speaking while the other man listens. The video returns to the first man for his concluding remarks. The segment ends with a blue end screen featuring a radial design, a large arrow pointing up with the text "PREVIOUS VIDEO", another large arrow pointing left with "SUBSCRIBE", and a banner that says "SMILE2JANNAH.COM ONLINE STORE". Below the banner, a circular arrangement of t-shirts and mugs with the "SMILE 2 JANNAH" logo is shown, centered with the text "OPEN NOW".
